cast.name: 埃洛拉·托尔基亚 Ellora Torchia

introduction: A lone survivor wakes up stranded on a rocky, empty coastline. With a mysterious beacon guiding her, she searches the landscape for food and shelter, looking for signs of civilization, people, anything. Finding only the crumbling remains of buildings long deserted, she becomes increasingly fearful of the reality of her situation, and when the beacons' final destination is revealed, she must come to terms with a fundamentally changed world.
